outcome: Adverse pregnancy outcomes (preterm delivery, preeclampsia, placental abruption, Apgar score <7 points 1 minute after birth, postpartum hemorrhage)
cohort: 113 women in their third trimester of pregnancy who did not receive thyroid medication
finding: Pregnant women with subclinical hypothyroidism had impaired mitochondrial function compared to euthyroid pregnant women, and this impairment may be associated with a higher prevalence of adverse pregnancy outcomes.
